items.title: Blood Urea
items.description: Helps detect metabolic and kidney disorders.
items.usage: Used to detect kidney dysfunction and protein metabolism disorders.

code.display: Biochemical evaluation of blood urea/renal function

items.title: Body Fluid analysis -biochemistry including Glucose, Protein, LDH
items.description: Comprehensive laboratory analysis of body fluids including physical, biochemical, and microscopic examination
items.usage: Used to evaluate effusions and diagnose infections, inflammation, malignancy, and metabolic conditions

items.title: Cerebro Spinal Fluid analysis (Biochemistry)
items.description: Biochemical analysis of cerebrospinal fluid for glucose and protein levels.
items.usage: Used in the diagnosis of meningitis, encephalitis and other CNS disorders.

items.title: Fasting Blood Sugar (FBS)
items.description: Measures the level of glucose in the blood in the fasting state
items.usage: Used to diagnose diabetes mellitus.

items.title: Glucose Tolerance Test (GTT)
items.description: Ordered to assess how the body processes glucose and to help diagnose diabetes or gestational diabetes.
items.usage: Used to diagnose diabetes mellitus.

items.title: Kidney Function Test (KFT)
items.description: Kidney Function Test panel measuring urea, creatinine and electrolytes to evaluate renal function.
items.usage: Used to assess renal function, monitor chronic kidney disease, and evaluate electrolyte balance.

items.title: Lipid profile
items.description: Measures cholesterol (Total, HDL, LDL) and triglycerides in the blood.
items.usage: Used to assess cardiovascular risk and monitor lipid-lowering therapy.

items.title: Liver function Test (LFT)
items.description: A panel of tests measuring enzymes, bilirubin, and proteins produced by the liver.
items.usage: A panel of tests measuring enzymes, bilirubin, and proteins produced by the liver.

code.display: Liver function study with serial images

items.title: Neonatal Bilirubin
items.description: Measurement of total, direct and indirect bilirubin in neonates.
items.usage: Used in evaluation and monitoring of neonatal jaundice and hemolytic disease of the newborn.

items.title: Post Prandial Blood Sugar (PPBS)
items.description: Measures the level of glucose in the blood after a meal, used to assess how the body processes sugar and to monitor diabetes control
items.usage: Used to monitor diabetes control.

items.title: Random Blood Sugar (RBS)
items.description: Measures the level of glucose in the blood.
items.usage: Used for diabetes screening.

items.title: Serum Albumin
items.description: Measures the level of albumin, the main protein in blood plasma produced by the liver
items.usage: Used to detect liver disease and kidney disorders.

items.title: Serum Amylase
items.description: Measures the level of amylase enzyme in the blood, mainly from the pancreas and salivary glands.
items.usage: Used to diagnose pancreatitis.

items.title: Serum Bicarbonate
items.description: Measures serum bicarbonate level for acid–base balance.
items.usage: Evaluates acid–base balance and metabolic or respiratory disorders.

items.title: Serum Calcium
items.description: Measures total calcium in the blood, essential for bone health, nerve signals, and muscle function.
items.usage: Used to evaluate bone metabolism and parathyroid function.

items.title: Serum Creatinine
items.description: Measures the level of creatinine in the blood, an indicator of kidney function.
items.usage: Used to assess kidney filtration efficiency.

items.title: Serum Electrolyte
items.description: Quantitative measurement of sodium, potassium and chloride in serum.
items.usage: Used to evaluate electrolyte imbalance, dehydration, and acid-base disorders.

items.title: Serum Glutamic Pyruvic Transaminase (SGPT)/ Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT)
items.description: Measures alanine aminotransferase, an enzyme released when liver cells are damaged.
items.usage: Used to detect liver injury.

items.title: Serum LDH
items.description: Measures LDH enzyme levels, which increase with tissue damage in many organs.
items.usage: Used to detect tissue injury.

items.title: Serum Lipase
items.description: Measures the level of lipase enzyme in the serum, which is primarily produced by the pancreas to break down fats.
items.usage: Used to diagnose pancreatitis.

items.title: Serum Phosphorus
items.description: Measures the level of phosphorus (phosphate) in the serum, which plays a key role in bone formation, energy production, and maintaining acid–base balance in the body.
items.usage: Plays a key role in bone formation, energy production, and maintaining acid–base balance.

items.title: Serum Potassium
items.description: Measures the level of potassium in the blood, an important electrolyte for heart and muscle function.
items.usage: Used to evaluate heart function and kidney health.

items.title: Serum Thyroid-Stimulating Hormone (S.TSH)
items.description: Measures thyroid-stimulating hormone levels in the blood to assess thyroid gland function.
items.usage: Used to diagnose hypothyroidism or hyperthyroidism and included in newborn screening to detect congenital hypothyroidism early.

code.display: Measurement of serum thyroid stimulating hormone

items.title: Serum Thyroxine (S.T4)
items.description: Measures total Thyroxine (bound + free) in serum to assess overall thyroid hormone status.
items.usage: Used alongside TSH to diagnose hypothyroidism or hyperthyroidism and monitor therapy.

items.title: Serum Total Protein
items.description: Measures the total amount of proteins in the blood, mainly albumin and globulins.
items.usage: Used to evaluate liver function and nutritional status.

items.title: Serum Triiodothyronine (S.T3)
items.description: Measures total Triiodothyronine (bound + free) in serum to evaluate thyroid hormone production.
items.usage: Used to assess hyperthyroidism and to evaluate abnormal TSH results.

items.title: Serum Uric acid
items.description: Measures uric acid levels formed from purine metabolism.
items.usage: Used to diagnose gout and kidney disorders.

items.title: Total serum bilirubin (TSB)
items.description: Measurement of total serum bilirubin to assess liver function and hemolytic conditions.
items.usage: Used for evaluation of jaundice, hepatobiliary disorders, and neonatal hyperbilirubinemia.

items.title: Troponin - I
items.description: Measures cardiac-specific proteins released into the blood when heart muscle is damaged.
items.usage: Used to diagnose acute myocardial infarction (heart attack), assess cardiac injury, and monitor high-risk patients with chest pain.
